content.label: So I was on a family trip with my four year old, and I installed a few games on our iPad for him to work through while we were on the road. He gravitated to a different game from this one, but I started playing it after he fell asleep one night, and it sucked me in and resonated with me in a way that’s hard to describe. I was not expecting much of a story, much less one that would speak so strongly to an adult audience, and while I think kids would absolutely appreciate the themes, I think it’s clear this was written for parents to play as much as kids. So thank you, I don’t know the last time I felt something from a video game, and this one was wonderful.

I don’t understand the positive reviews.  The underlying premise of this game is basically to throw legos randomly into place in any manner that approximates a path, regardless of whether they are supported from below, fit together well structurally, or express anything meaningful or artful.  It barely qualifies as a puzzle.  It’s ugly, boring, and the controls are terrible.

title.label: I want to love it, BUT…

The game is pretty brilliant actually, and I do enjoy it, but there are two elements that I find really annoying:
1. The inability to zoom in closer.  The lighting is quite odd on several levels and it’s very difficult to see what pieces are even available.  I don’t have terrible vision but I feel like my eyes are strained many times trying to see what I’m working with. 
2. The inability to rotate the level 360 degrees.  Many other games that remind me of this one will allow you the flip the view around however you want, which would make this more fun and less frustrating.

title.label: better than I could have ever imagined

content.label:
I wasn’t seeming a lot of talk about this game, so I wasn’t sure what to expect when I opened it. and I’ve only been playing a few minutes so far but it’s so good I had to stop for a second to write this review.

The lighting and graphics are really satisfying, as a lego collector, the builds and building techniques are really unique and the animations are awesome. the animations are made up of different bricks that change really fast, there was some mud bubbles coming up in one of the levels, and I could see a 1x1 round stud, followed by a mini figure head, and technic ball, some different types of flowers, a bandana, and then a darth maul hair piece. each one lasted about a frame and they were all in the same brown color. It was like watching a really creative stop motion.

also the haptic feedback is really well integrated and makes it feel like i’m actually building legos when I place bricks down and pick them up. And the gyroscope usage hasn’t gone unnoticed either, when I tilt my phone the camera follows. it’s all just really satisfying and just well built.
Really needs better controls. Finished the first few levels but controls are so inconsistent is just not worth sticking with.

This was the possibly MOST fun I've ever had with A LEGO game. My only problem was that I ran out of levels too fast. All I want is to play more!!! :( I also maybe want a sequel because I want to find out what happens to the robot.

I haven’t started the game over but it looks like I’m back to square one. Hopefully more levels and puzzles will appear in future updates.

This is an excellent game with an implicit story and built-in tutorial that masterfully exposes the plot and gameplay elements in a well-paced fashion. I am playing through this with a controller; I can imagine that mouse and keyboard on a pc would also be a good way to play this game. The game is simple but delightful; the music and graphics are amazing. Check this out on an RTX graphics card on PC with ray tracing to be really blown away.
For a game as strikingly beautiful with an original and compelling story, the gameplay is quite boring and controls terribly unintuitive
This is a very awesome puzzle game.   The only “complaint” I have… and really is more of a suggestion or compliment…. It is tooooo short of a game…. PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE create more levels!!!!!
